# Atlantic City: Tax Evasion - Accounting Terminal Locations

With thanks to Coffee888, Mephiston, and Gaurst.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

Purge the accounting records from the terminals.

There are 8 possible spawn locations for the Accounting Terminals, with only 4 spawning per expedition.

The terminals can be interacted with and unlocked, in any order, by both the Team Leader and Teammates.

From the front door of the Casino, walk forward a few steps and turn right. Walk over and unlock the elevator.

Drop down to the bottom of the elevator shaft, open the elevator door, and walk out into the main room.

**Terminal Location # 1**

From the directions above, face North and enter the room via the door on your left. A terminal can spawn on the desk in the office.

**Terminal Location # 2**

Exit the room above and face East. Walk forward and stop in the middle of the room. Turn and face North and a terminal can spawn on the desk in front of you.

**Terminal Location # 3**

Turn and face North. Take the stairs on your left, follow the path around, and enter the door on your left. Continue to follow the path around and go up the stairs. At the top of the stairs, turn left, follow the path around, and stop at the top of the stairs. A terminal can spawn on the desk, in front of you.

**Terminal Location # 4**

Turn around and go back to the same room that has the vault door and Terminal Location # 2.

Face South. Take the stairs on your left, walk straight, follow the corridor, and stop at the top of the stairs. You should be looking at a blue metal tank. There is a set of stairs directly opposite you, you will need to walk around the tank to get to them.

Face East and walk up the stairs. Follow the path (there is only one way you can go) and stop at the bottom of the wooden stairs.

Turn left and the terminal can spawn on the metal cabinet, against the Eastern wall, under the stairs.

Follow the wooden stairs to the top and open the double doors in front of you. You will now be on the Casino floor.

**Terminal Location # 5**

From the doors above, face North and follow the red carpet path. Take the second red carpet path on your right and follow it until you reach the area in front of the stage. Face South, jump onto the stage and the terminal can spawn on the table, on your right.

**Terminal Location # 6**

Stand on the stage and look NW. You should be able to see the World's Biggest Slot Machine from the stage. Walk over to the World's Biggest Slot Machine. Walk forward a few steps and enter the door on your left.

Walk West until you hit the wall, turn right, walk straight, and stop at the ice machine on your left. Face North and enter the kitchen. The terminal can spawn on one of the metal counters next to the yellow sinks.

**Terminal Location # 7**

Walk back to the ice machine and face East. Walk forward a few steps and turn left. Follow the corridor down until you see the room marked "Security" on your left. Enter the room and the terminal can spawn on the desk in front of you.

**Terminal Location # 8**

Exit the Security office and turn North. Follow the corridor around, until you are standing back out on the casino floor (first door on your right). Walk forward until you are standing on the red carpet path, you should be facing a roll of slot machines. Turn East and walk straight over to the door in front of you. Open the door and enter the room. The terminal can spawn on the desk, opposite the tinkers bench.
